title: Google says Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available across AI Studio, the Gemini API, Search, paid AI Pro and Ultra tiers in Antigravity, and more (Abner Li/9to5Google)
summary: Abner Li / 9to5Google: Google says Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available across AI Studio, the Gemini API, Search, paid AI Pro and Ultra tiers in Antigravity, and more — After this week's Carbon availability, Google today unveiled Gemini 4 Hydrogen instead of keeping the “Flash” branding.
